name: population-census-2024
title: Population and households of Uganda by parish, 2024 census
description: Population by sex, household population, number of households and average household size for districts, counties, sub-counties and parishes, from the UBOS National Population and Housing Census 2024 sub-region profile reports, linked to the administrative units in this portal.

sources.title: Uganda Bureau of Statistics (UBOS), National Population and Housing Census 2024, sub-region profile reports (Volume 2)

knownIssues: Figures were extracted from the UBOS PDF reports. A table was kept only where every parent equals the sum of its children; about a dozen district tables (or parts of them) failed that check and are left out.
Census names are matched to portal units by name within their parent. Units the portal has under a different name or parent, and new units, have no figures (about 8% of parishes).
UBOS district figures include the municipalities inside the district; the portal lists municipal councils separately, with their own figures.
Where the portal has the same place twice, the figures go to the entry with the most children.

changelog.note: First publication: population by sex and households for districts, counties, sub-counties and parishes.
